name: What is the average cost per square foot for bathroom tile installation in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost per square foot for bathroom tile installation in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of bathroom tile installation in the Bay Area can vary significantly based on factors like tile material, complexity of the layout, and labor rates. On average, you might expect to pay between $10 to $25 per square foot for labor alone. This does not include the cost of the tile itself, which can range from $2 to $50+ per square foot depending on the material (ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, etc.). Demolition, subfloor preparation, and custom designs will also impact the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: In the Bay Area, bathroom tile installation labor typically costs $10-$25 per square foot, not including tile materials. Total costs depend on material choice and project complexity.
